import pandas as pd


def run(inputs: dict) -> dict:
    df = inputs["invoices"].copy()

    amount = df["amount"]
    tax = df["tax"]
    due_date = df["due_date"]
    customer_ref = df["customer_ref"]

    r1 = amount.isna() | (amount < 0)
    r2 = tax.isna() | (tax < 0)
    r3 = (~amount.isna()) & (~tax.isna()) & (tax > amount * 0.5)
    r4 = due_date.isna()

    def ref_empty(v):
        if v is None:
            return True
        try:
            if pd.isna(v):
                return True
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            pass
        if isinstance(v, str):
            return v.strip() == ""
        return False

    r5 = customer_ref.apply(ref_empty)

    rules = [
        (r1, "AMT_BAD"),
        (r2, "TAX_BAD"),
        (r3, "TAX_EXCESS"),
        (r4, "DUE_NULL"),
        (r5, "REF_EMPTY"),
    ]

    n = len(df)
    reason_codes = [[] for _ in range(n)]
    for mask, code in rules:
        mask_values = mask.values
        for i in range(n):
            if mask_values[i]:
                reason_codes[i].append(code)

    reason_str = ["|".join(codes) for codes in reason_codes]
    has_fail = [len(codes) > 0 for codes in reason_codes]

    df_reason = pd.Series(reason_str, index=df.index)
    fail_mask = pd.Series(has_fail, index=df.index)

    invoices_clean = df.loc[~fail_mask].copy()

    invoices_rejects = df.loc[fail_mask].copy()
    invoices_rejects["reason_codes"] = df_reason.loc[fail_mask]

    return {
        "invoices_clean": invoices_clean,
        "invoices_rejects": invoices_rejects,
    }
